inputs.text: The policies of the US, Israel, and Iran are driving up global oil prices and exposing India's dangerous dependence on foreign energy supplies that undermines our national strength. Working families and laborers are the ones bearing the real cost through higher energy expenses, which strains their households and weakens the family values essential to a stable society. Petrol and diesel prices have not risen yet, but the government's cut to excise duties is just a temporary band-aid that will drain resources from vital national priorities and let inflation hit ordinary working people the hardest. Our heavy reliance on imported crude oil shows the damage from years of misguided international policies, not some fabricated story about historical global exploitation. What we need is a firm focus on building self-reliance and personal responsibility within a strong national framework, instead of falling for progressive pushes for institutional reforms that only prop up unstable global systems and erode our cultural foundations.
